facts.fact: Telkom's investor presentation lists BCX Tier IV certified data centres Midrand NDC 1 (2004), Midrand NDC 2 (2006) and Bellville 2 (2009), and says 3 of South Africa's 4 certified Tier IV data centres are owned and operated by BCX.
facts.system: BCX Midrand NDC 1; Midrand NDC 2; Bellville 2

facts.fact: Telkom's presentation states BCX's Centurion Hub data centre is Tier III certified (2002), with 2,850 m2 white space and 1.8 MW critical load.

note: Document does not say outright that BCX's centres rent to outsiders (a slide lists public data centre operators and BCX managed cloud). Other BCX sites (Tier 2/3 compliant) not recorded as tier3.
